verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document per-project event quotas, hard caps, or spend limits. The only related item is pricing-page 'Spike protection', which 'detects and flags' irregular volumes. That is a detection and flagging control, not a quota cap or a budget ceiling, so it earns no credit. The 'ignore for a number of occurrences' status rule (docs-11) is error-group triage, not a quota or billing cap.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can cap event quotas per project and set spend limits so an error storm burns a predictable budget, never a surprise invoice

citations.quote: Spike protection. Detect and flag irregular data volumes to avoid any surprise usage
